notes.title: Bug fixes and a little bit more
notes.notes:
What's new:
Bug for levels refusing to load should be patched.
The game has been built using a different method which makes it so that the next updates will take much less time and data.
Downgraded to Unity 2022 instead of Unity 6 due to stability issues.

Notes:
This is a relativly easy game to run and a gaming grade PC should be able to easily run it at 1000FPS
Please don't run it at 1000FPS, it was not made to run at that speed and many stability issues have occured entirly based on running it at above that frame rate. Please cap it to something normal like 60, 120, 144, 165, or 240, even 360, just no 1000FPS. Thank you.
